# Globe-Tech Innovations

> Globe-Tech Innovations is an engineering and automation solutions company providing industrial automation, entrance automation, security and access solutions, and customized engineering systems.

## Company

Globe-Tech Innovations provides engineering, automation and technology solutions for commercial and industrial applications. The company focuses on customized systems designed around safety, efficiency, security, accessibility and operational requirements.

Headquarters:
CST No. 344, Plot No. 419,
Sion-Trombay Road, next to Victory Container Yard,
Opp. Vijay Sales, Suman Nagar, Chembur,
Mumbai, Maharashtra 400071, India

Website: https://www.globetechinnovations.com/
Email: support@globetechinnovations.com

## Main Products

### High Speed Doors
High-speed door solutions designed for efficient movement, operational efficiency and industrial environments.

### Platform Screen Doors
Platform screen door systems designed to improve passenger safety and controlled access in transportation environments.

### Rolling Shutters
Rolling shutter solutions providing protection, security and controlled access for commercial and industrial applications.

### Boom Barriers
Automated boom barrier systems for vehicle access control and security applications.

### Entrance Automation
Automated entrance and access solutions designed for commercial, industrial and architectural applications.

### Loading Bay Solutions
Loading and logistics solutions designed to improve safety, efficiency and operational flow around loading areas.

### Security Systems
Automation and access-control solutions supporting security and controlled movement across facilities.

## Industries Served

Globe-Tech Innovations provides automation solutions for industries including:

- Automobile
- Pharmaceutical
- Food and Beverage
- Warehousing

## Solutions

The company provides customized engineering and automation solutions with an emphasis on:

- Entrance automation
- Industrial automation
- Access control
- Security
- Loading bay automation
- Automated doors
- Customized engineering solutions
- Safety and operational efficiency
